title: Broken!!
body: Hey there! Just wanted to let you guys know that I love your That Girl calendar app! body: To have a wellness app without a free version isn't fair to all the clientele that want to use a scheduling and wellness app. It's annoying and frustrating that the app pitches you and gives a glamorized speech of its features just to immediately have to a) delete the app after getting excited about the features or b) pay an unreasonable subscription fee.

title: Pay to Use
body: Not cool that there’s no trial option… I’m not gonna bother paying money straight off the bat to use an app that does the same thing that the Reminders app in my phone does. Then again, I could be wrong and it could be a really great app, but I’m not gonna spend $$ to find out if I’m right or wrong it’s just not worth it.
